assets.name: 기준 영웅
assets.desc: full body of a young village leader and pioneer, hanbok-inspired practical tunic in muted green with brown trousers and leather boots, rolled-up sleeves, short dark hair, determined friendly face, small hatchet hanging at the belt, standing idle facing the viewer, arms relaxed at sides, feet planted on the bottom edge, heroic but humble proportions around seven heads tall

assets.name: 늑대
assets.desc: full body of a lean gray wolf in side view walking stance, hackles slightly raised, bared teeth, hungry amber eyes, matted fur in cool gray tones with darker back and lighter belly, bushy tail low, all four paws on the bottom edge, wild and threatening but not cartoonish

assets.name: 움집

assets.name: 큰 참나무

assets.name: 바위 노드
assets.desc: a cluster of three large angular boulders for mining, big faceted planes of gray stone with chipped edges and small cracks, a few pebbles scattered at the base, subtle moss patch on the shaded side, sturdy and weighty, base flush with the bottom edge
